title: Policy Knowledge Graph Explorer: a multi-model semantic knowledge graph for exploring environmental governance corpora (v2, 191-document corpus)
description:
An interactive knowledge-graph tool that maps the semantic relationships across a corpus of 191 Irish, EU and international environmental-governance documents spanning climate, water, biodiversity, agriculture, forestry and cross-cutting policy domains.

Documents are segmented into ~350-word passages, embedded with a three-model ensemble (BGE-M3, Qwen3-Embedding-0.6B and MiniLM) combined by similarity-matrix averaging, and assembled into a document-level similarity graph. Connection strength is calibrated non-parametrically against the corpus's own background similarity distribution (weak / moderate / strong bands at mean + 1σ / 1.5σ / 2σ). The output is a single standalone, client-side HTML application offering linked 2D network, 3D orbit and heatmap views, plus a reference-datum mode that re-centres the display on any chosen document.

The deposit contains the full processing pipeline; the segmented text corpus underlying the graph (13,871 passages, approximately 5.07 million words, drawn from the 191 documents); a catalogue of the wider 300-document source library from which those 191 were selected, with provenance, publisher URLs and text-quality flags; the built interactive explorer; the technical specification; and a policy brief. Original publisher PDFs are not redistributed — the catalogue records where each was obtained — and the embedding matrices are omitted as they are large and fully regenerable from the deposited segments.

Status: research / decision-support tool. Semantic similarity measures thematic overlap, not agreement, legal consistency or policy coherence; outputs are a prompt for expert review, not an automated assessment.
